message:
Exhausted this week by the work of teaching, it's refreshing to read the statements of teaching philosophy folks are passing around and posting in prep for the job search. What you have here delights me, I think, because it manages to convey an infectious enthusiasm, something I don't mind catching right now. :)

I've also seen some statements of teaching phil that never answer the question "So, what do you *dooo*?" You show very well what happens when your theory hits the road ... nice!
